assertions.subject: Antiviral drug resistance
assertions.quote: The emergence of drug-resistant strains can limit the efficacy of antiviral therapy

assertions.subject: Antiviral drug resistance
assertions.quote: Viral genomes can evolve resistance to drugs by mutation and selection

assertions.subject: Antiviral drug resistance
assertions.quote: Viral genomes can evolve resistance to drugs by mutation and selection, by recombination with a drug-resistant virus

assertions.subject: Antiviral drug resistance
assertions.quote: Viral genomes can evolve resistance to drugs by mutation and selection, by recombination with a drug-resistant virus, or (in the case of influenza virus and other segmented RNA viral genomes) by reassortment

assertions.subject: HIV
assertions.quote: Resistance to reverse transcriptase or protease inhibitors has been associated with specific mutations in the reverse transcriptase or protease genes

assertions.subject: Herpesviruses
assertions.quote: Drug resistance also can arise in herpesviruses but is a less common clinical problem
